hotels.title: Grand Opening: Coastal Vietnam Pool Suites & Villas with Nightly Dinner & Free-Flow Drinks Hour
hotels.description: Retreat to this lush sanctuary on the shores of Bao Ninh Beach, where a blissful balance is found in the warm breeze and cool waters. Situated between Da Nang and Hanoi, Quang Binh is a province renowned for its natural beauty, with stellar beaches and magnificent cave systems to explore. From the first step into this coastal haven, your serene escape is framed by tranquil gardens, in-suite dining and nightly cocktail hour at Oasis Pool Bar. Make the most of daily breakfast at Flamingo Restaurant & Bar before wandering down to Bao Ninh Beach or heading into town to uncover the hidden gem of Dong Hoi. Visit the limestone caves of Phong Nha-Ke Bang National Park, then return to the resort for a full-body massage at Yên Spa & Wellness and a three-course dinner.
